description: Plays one round of a solo invented luck game for Luck Points (commit, then settle). Get its outcomes and stake menu from get_invented_game first. Needs a key with "Play luck games (single player)" on. Multiplayer invented games are played in rooms (join_room). Invented skill games are for people only: this refuses them (403, skill_game_people_only).

clientSeed.description: Your seed, 1..64 chars (random if left out)

stake.description: Luck Points (on its stake menu if it has one)

name: play_invented_game
title: Play an invented luck game
